answer: Copying the same citations across 288 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 288 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the terrace check immediately, the shale audit keeps the resolved set and the raven replay exposes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
